wins.label: Record Revenue
wins.evidence: Broadcom distributed a press release and financial tables after the market closed, describing our financial performance for the third quarter of fiscal year 2025. If you did not receive a copy, you may obtain the information from the Investors section of Broadcom's website at broadcom.com.

wins.label: AI Semiconductor Growth
wins.evidence: In our fiscal Q3 2025, total revenue was a record $16 billion, up 22% year-on-year. Now revenue growth was driven by better-than-expected strength in AI semiconductors and our continued growth in VMware. Q3 consolidated adjusted EBITDA was a record $10.7 billion, up 30% year-on-year.

wins.label: XPU Acceleration
wins.evidence: Q3 semiconductor revenue was $9.2 billion as year-on-year growth accelerated to 26% year-on-year. And this accelerated growth was driven by AI semiconductor revenue of $5.2 billion, which was up 63% year-on-year and extend the trajectory of robust growth to 10 consecutive quarters.

wins.label: Significant Backlog
wins.evidence: Now looking beyond what we are just reporting this quarter, with robust demand from AI, bookings were extremely strong. And our current consolidated backlog for the company hit a record of $110 billion.

wins.label: Software Revenue Growth
wins.evidence: Infrastructure software revenue of $6.8 billion was up 17% year-on-year, above our outlook of $6.7 billion as bookings continued to be strong during the quarter. We booked, in fact, total contract value over $8.4 billion during Q3.

risks.label: Non-AI Semiconductor Slowdown
risks.evidence: Demand continues to be slow to recover, and Q3 revenue of $4 billion was flat sequentially.

risks.label: Network Scaling Challenges
risks.evidence: Demand continued to be strong because networking is becoming critical as LLMs continue to evolve in intelligence and compute clusters have to grow bigger. The network is the computer, and our customers are facing challenges as they scale to clusters beyond 100,000 compute nodes.

risks.label: Inventory Levels
risks.evidence: We ended the third quarter with inventory of $2.2 billion, up 8% sequentially in anticipation of revenue growth next quarter.

risks.label: Market Uncertainty
risks.evidence: As I said, it's a journey. It's a multiyear journey because it's multigenerational, because these XPUs don't stay still either. And with each newer generation, they increase the consumption, the usage of the XPU. As they gain confidence, as the model improves, they deploy it even more.

risks.label: Competition
risks.evidence: Well, you know I'm biased to be honest. But it's a competition that -- it's an area that we always see competition and our only way to secure our position is we try to out-invest and out-innovate anybody else in this game.
